content: NPM proxy-host automation: Terraform provider Sander0542/nginxproxymanager v1.3.0 (May 2026) manages proxy hosts, certs, SSL settings, websockets declaratively via NPM REST API. Older saffronjam provider stale (2022). Direct REST API (/api/tokens, /api/nginx/proxy-hosts) also scriptable for a CLI scaffolder. No external-dns-style k8s controller for NPM exists — this is the gap requiring Terraform or custom automation.
